details.name: Description
details.value:
EverC, now part of G2 Risk Solutions, is a pioneer in its field. By leveraging technologies that illuminate the darkest corners of the internet and provide unparalleled visibility into the largest source of data in the world, EverC uses artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques to assess hundreds of millions of domains and effectively categorize the internet. These insights reveal hidden relationships and risks, identify an entity’s full digital fingerprint, and create new opportunities for businesses to scale efficiently and confidently. 

About the Role 

We’re looking for a hands-on Data Scientist who owns AI and LLM-powered products end to end — and cares about how they perform for real users. 

You will own the modeling and evaluation of our fraud and risk detection products: exploring the data, designing models and prompts, evaluating them offline, and monitoring them in production. You’ll work side by side with engineers to ship your models into large-scale, real-time systems — you drive the data science and the product outcomes, while engineering owns the platform plumbing. 

This is a data science role at heart. You won’t be a data engineer, but you’ll be comfortable working close to the data and the systems, and knowing your way around modern ML and data infrastructure is a strong plus. 

Responsibilities 

Data Science & Modeling 

  • Own the design, build, and evaluation of LLM-based and classical ML models for classification, entity extraction, and risk scoring on large-scale, real-world data. 
  • Lead prompt design and iteration — model configurations, fallback strategies, and tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. 
  • Apply sound statistical judgment on adversarial, noisy, or imperfectly labeled data. 
  • Drive the modeling decisions behind how LLMs and ML models fit into streaming, event-driven production systems. 

Product & Platform Partnership 

  • Partner with engineers to ship your models into real-time streaming and large-scale batch pipelines — you own the modeling, they own the platform. 
  • Shape internal evaluation tooling, LLM observability, and model-performance monitoring. 
  • Define the requirements your infrastructure must meet to support rapid experimentation without hurting production reliability. 

Data Quality & Product Performance 

  • Own the data-quality and product metrics that matter (precision, recall, coverage, latency, cost efficiency). 
  • Build measurement frameworks for production systems and offline experiments. 
  • Analyze production data to find labeling gaps, false-positive patterns, and new detection opportunities. 
  • Drive experimentation (A/B tests, shadow deployments, offline evaluation) and back every decision with measurable business outcomes.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 5+ years applied data science / ML, including production model deployment. 
  • Hands-on LLM prompt engineering and evaluation (not just fine-tuning theory). 
  • Strong Python. 
  • Experience with large-scale data processing concepts and technologies. 
  • Strong grasp of data-intensive applications and modern data architectures. 
  • Experience building cloud-native systems (AWS preferred). 
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management. 
  • Comfortable with ambiguous, adversarial data and designing labels/heuristics where ground truth is imperfect. 

Preferred Qualifications 

A data scientist who is also fluent in the ML and data-engineering stack is a big plus: 

  • Data & Infrastructure: Apache Spark, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, EMR, Airflow, Iceberg / Delta Lake, K8s 
  • Cloud & DevOps: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), monitoring & observability platforms 
  • AI & ML: ML platforms, LLM-powered applications, vector databases

details.name: Description
details.value:
G2 Risk Solutions helps organizations make safer, smarter business decisions through risk, compliance, and merchant monitoring solutions. We serve a global customer base across multiple industries and geographies, partnering with customers to solve complex business challenges while delivering measurable business outcomes. 

G2 Risk Solutions is seeking a Director, Customer Success - Americas to lead our Customer Success organization across North America and Latin America.

This leader is accountable for the retention, growth, and overall health of the Americas customer portfolio, serving as the senior Customer Success leader for the region and primary counterpart to regional Sales leadership.

The Director will lead a team of approximately seven Customer Success Managers responsible for managing G2RS's strategic and enterprise customer portfolio across North America and Latin America. The team serves as trusted advisors to customers, ensuring value realization, retention, growth, and long-term partnership success.

Success in this role requires a strong blend of commercial acumen, customer leadership, operational excellence, and cross-functional influence. The Director will partner closely with Sales, Compliance Operations, Product, Support, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to ensure customers realize measurable value from G2RS solutions while contributing directly to company growth objectives.

This role owns the success of the Americas customer portfolio and is accountable for Net Revenue Retention (NRR), customer retention, customer outcomes, and Customer Success Qualified Lead (CSQL) generation across the region.

Strong preference for the candidate to be located on the US East Coast.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
·        8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, Enterprise Account Management, Consulting, or related customer-facing leadership roles.

·        3+ years of experience leading Customer Success, Account Management, or post-sales teams.

·        Demonstrated success managing strategic or enterprise customer portfolios with accountability for retention, renewals, and growth.

·        Experience leading executive-level customer engagements and navigating complex stakeholder environments.

·        Experience building and scaling customer success, account management, or customer retention programs.

·        Experience in B2B SaaS, technology, data, or information services organizations preferred.

·        Experience in risk management, compliance, payments, fraud prevention, fintech, or related industries preferred.

·        Experience using Salesforce, HubSpot, and customer success technologies to manage customer lifecycles and portfolio performance preferred.

·        Strong commercial acumen and experience identifying and influencing growth opportunities within existing customer relationships.

·        Strong analytical, forecasting, and business planning capabilities.

·        Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.

·        Experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones preferred.

·        Ability and willingness to travel periodically to support customer engagement, executive business reviews, industry events, and internal meetings.

·        Bachelor's degree preferred.


﻿This range represents the low and high end of the anticipated base salary range. The actual base salary will depend on several factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, and location of the job.

Remote, US Base Salary Range: $170,000 - $190,000

details.name: Description
details.value:
G2 Risk Solutions helps organizations make safer, smarter business decisions through risk, compliance, and merchant monitoring solutions. We serve a global customer base across multiple industries and geographies, partnering with customers to solve complex business challenges while delivering measurable business outcomes. 

This is a senior role at the heart of our Bankruptcy Risk business. As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will lead relationships with some of our most strategically important customers, own their retention and renewal, and partner with Sales on growth. You will help major financial institutions realize lasting value from our solutions.

In this role, you will build relationships across customer teams, understand what they need to achieve, and bring the right people together to address complex challenges. You will work with Business Operations, Sales, Product, and Engineering to turn that understanding into better customer outcomes.

Your customers include banks, credit unions, lenders, mortgage servicers, debt buyers, and collection agencies. Our bankruptcy solutions help them move from detecting a filing to monitoring a case, filing a claim, and tracking recovery. You will help these organizations get value from that work across complex, consequential operations.

Key responsibilities

  • Own retention and renewal for a portfolio of Bankruptcy Risk accounts, including some of our largest and most strategic customers. Set renewal strategy early and lead commercial discussions and contract changes with Sales and Legal to protect recurring revenue.
  • Develop a clear strategy for each major account, grounded in the customer’s priorities, adoption, risks, and opportunities. Align internal partners around the outcomes that will strengthen the relationship over time.
  • Proactively monitor customer health across the portfolio, identify risk early, and own the response. Build and execute mitigation and recovery plans through resolution, drawing on teams and resources across the organization to protect relationships and revenue.
  • Partner with Sales to identify and develop growth opportunities across our bankruptcy solutions, using your understanding of each customer’s goals, workflows, and unmet needs to shape the opportunity.
  • Build trusted relationships across each customer organization, from day-to-day users to senior decision-makers. Lead senior-level customer engagement to understand changing priorities, strengthen sponsorship, and advance the relationship.
  • Lead strategic business reviews that start with the customer’s priorities, show the outcomes our solutions are delivering, and create a substantive conversation about what comes next.
  • Lead the customer relationship through onboarding and implementation, partnering with Business Operations, Product, and Engineering to help customers go live, adopt the solution, and realize value as quickly as possible.
  • Bring customer feedback, emerging needs, and recurring points of friction to Product and Operations. Work with those teams to improve the customer experience and help shape future solutions.
  • Help customers use our solutions effectively through tailored education that connects platform capabilities to their bankruptcy workflows and business goals.
  • Own the customer relationship when questions or service issues arise, coordinating with the appropriate teams to reach a timely resolution and keeping the customer informed.
  • Lead and motivate the team, setting clear priorities and holding people accountable for results.
  • Continuously evaluate processes, workflows, and tools to find areas for improvement, and drive changes that increase efficiency and quality.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Critical skills

  • Enterprise account management and executive relationship leadership with senior stakeholders at regulated financial institutions
  • Commercial acumen, including renewal strategy, identifying and developing growth opportunities with Sales, and working with the broader commercial team on complex renewals
  • Ability to master complex, workflow-driven products and customer-specific implementations and to discuss them credibly with customer leaders
  • Analytical and forecasting capability, using usage, renewal, and account health data to identify risk and opportunity
  • Executive communication and influence across a matrixed organization, with independent ownership of a portfolio

Qualifications

  • 5 or more years in Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, Enterprise Account Management, or a related customer-facing role with enterprise customers
  • Demonstrated success managing strategic or enterprise portfolios with accountability for retention and renewals, and partnering with Sales on growth
  • Experience leading executive-level customer engagements and navigating complex stakeholder environments
  • Experience in bankruptcy, collections, consumer lending, mortgage servicing, or financial services strongly preferred
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, technology, data, or information services preferred
  • Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, and customer success technologies preferred
  • Bachelor's degree preferred

﻿This range represents the low and high end of the anticipated base salary range. The actual base salary will depend on several factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, and location of the job.

Remote, US Base Salary Range: $90,000 - $110,000

details.value:
Location: Remote (US, Eastern Time Zone)

The Senior Product Manager for G2 Risk Solutions (G2RS) Merchant Risk Solutions (MRS) will own a portfolio of established merchant onboarding and monitoring products used by financial institutions and payment providers worldwide. This role will initially lead the modernization of key underlying platform capabilities and expand to owning product strategy and growth for innovative solutions on our next-generation platform.

G2RS is here to keep e-commerce and merchant portfolios safe from illicit products and services. We work with the world’s leading fintech players and global marketplaces to unlock new business opportunities by highlighting the legitimate activity on their platforms and ensuring a swift and effective removal of bad actors. We build AI-powered solutions that transform complex data into actionable insights, enabling customers to manage risk, spot emerging trends, and respond quickly through a single unified experience.

Our product team consists of passionate people working together, inspiring each other, and empowering everyone around them to succeed and grow. As a key product leader, you will collaborate closely with Engineering, Data Science, Customer Success, Sales, and Operations teams around the world to translate business requirements into actionable features and experiences. You will work with clients and internal stakeholders to collect insights, validate proposed solutions, and maintain the market-leading standards of MRS products in risk detection, monitoring, and management.

This role requires a proactive, strategic thinker who is comfortable owning complex, interconnected products end-to-end and navigating shared ownership with other product managers. You will dive deep into data models and integrations, apply strong analytical skills to evaluate performance and build business cases, and keep initiatives aligned across cross-functional teams.

Position may require travel 2-3 times per year.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the roadmap and prioritization for a portfolio of merchant onboarding and monitoring products, balancing product stability, client commitments, and long-term platform direction.
  • Drive modernization of core platform capabilities, building business cases that balance cost, quality, and scalability.
  • Lead customer transition strategy as products evolve onto new capabilities, in collaboration with Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Engineering.
  • Own product strategy and growth for the portfolio, using market, competitive, and customer research to identify opportunities and shape the roadmap.
  • Apply AI-first thinking both in product development and daily workflows, incorporating responsible AI capabilities into the roadmap while using AI tools to accelerate research, requirements development, customer insights synthesis, and execution.
  • Engage directly with key customers to understand use cases, gather feedback, validate hypotheses, and ensure product-market fit.
  • Define and prioritize features, writing clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for Engineering and Data Science partners, and manage backlogs and delivery progress in Jira.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to guide development, ensure delivery milestones are met, and remove roadblocks throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Monitor product performance and customer outcomes using analytical methods, and champion a data-driven approach to prioritization and product decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Operations to support go-to-market efforts and ensure product launch readiness.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in data, AI/ML, and/or fintech.
  • Experience leading platform modernization or customer transition programs.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, data-driven or analytical products, from concept through launch and iteration.
  • Strong technical fluency, including working SQL skills, experience with customer-facing APIs, and the ability to dive into a data model and understand it in detail.
  • Experience building business cases, including vendor evaluation, unit economics, and build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Fintech, payments, KYB/KYC, and/or e-commerce risk and compliance experience is preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools in day-to-day product work (e.g., Copilot, generative AI assistants) and experience collaborating with Data Science to translate business problems into practical, ethical AI-enabled product solutions.
  • Proven ability to translate customer needs and business objectives into clear product requirements and actionable development plans.
  • Excellent collaboration skills and experience working with Engineering, Data Science, Operations, and GTM teams, including teams distributed across time zones.
  • Comfort with evolving scope and shared ownership across multiple product teams.
  • Strong analytical skills for modeling, KPI analysis, and trend evaluation.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfortable engaging with customers and external stakeholders to gather insights, validate assumptions, and build strong relationships.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, analytics, computer science, or a related field (MBA or advanced degree a plus).

﻿This range represents the low and high end of the anticipated base salary range. The actual base salary will depend on several factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, and location of the job.

Remote, US Base Salary Range: $125,000 - $145,000

details.value:
About the Role 

EverC, now part of G2 Risk Solutions, is a pioneer in its field. By using technologies that illuminate the darkest corners of the internet and provide unparalleled visibility into the largest source of data in the world, the internet. EverC uses artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques to assess hundreds of millions of domains and effectively categorize the internet. These insights shine a light on hidden relationships and risks, identify an entity’s full digital fingerprint, and reveal new opportunities to scale businesses efficiently and confidently.

Your opportunity:

We are looking for a passionate software engineer to help us build the foundation for storing and serving the data of the company's product of the future. As a Software Engineer you’ll be expected to:

  • Be fully hands-on, lead your parts from A-Z (why, what, how), continuously raise the bar.
  • Drive the engineering efforts in a cross-functional squad.

Your day-to-day:

  • Design, develop and influence how we process data at scale, together with amazing people.
  • Solve diverse complex problems of scale, performance and business logic.
  • Work in an agile development methodology.
  • Review code, architecture and data to identify and troubleshoot problems and areas for improvement and optimization.
  • Share knowledge and mentor other engineers.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• Expertise in Java or Python with at least 5+ years of experience in backend development of streaming application at scale.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed systems in production.
  • Experience with microservices-based architecture.
  • Experience designing and implementing large-scale apps in production
  • Proficiency in Kubernetes & Kafka (or equivalent streaming enabler).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
  • Good Communication skills.
  • Team player, hard worker, quick learner, independent and loves challenges.
  • Fluent in English.
  • BSC in Computer Science or equivalent.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with Spark, Scala, Airflow
  • Experience with columnar storage formats and OLAP systems for optimized analytical querying and data storage
  • Experience with CI/CD systems (Git Actions, ArgoCD).
  • Experience with infrastructure tools such as Cloud Formation and Terraform.
  • Experience with agentic tools.
